title: Vehicle Purchase Agreements — Number of Orders a Customer May Hold
content:
**Clause.** A customer may hold any number of orders under Vehicle Purchase Agreements over time, one order per vehicle. There is no lifetime cap on the number of orders a customer holds. How many orders may be open before handover at the same time is governed by the open pre-handover order cap.

**Restated.**

| Question the rule answers | Answer |
|---|---|
| Is there a maximum number of purchase orders per customer over the life of the relationship? | No; the number is unlimited. |
| How many vehicles does one purchase order cover? | One. |
| Does this clause decide how many orders may be open before handover at once? | No; that number is set by the open pre-handover order cap. |

**Hypothetical illustration.** A repeat Kestrel buyer who has completed four purchases and returned one vehicle in the past still holds no lifetime limit; a fifth vehicle is reserved on its own new order.
